# Security Policy

## Scope

This policy applies to:

- `https://monedario.cl/`
- The source code and content published from this repository

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not open public GitHub issues for security reports.

Send vulnerability reports to `security@monedario.cl`.

When possible, include:

- A clear description of the issue and affected URL or component
- Reproduction steps or proof of concept
- Impact assessment
- Any suggested remediation

## Response Targets

- Initial acknowledgement within 3 business days
- Status update within 14 calendar days

## Safe Handling Expectations

Please:

- Avoid accessing, modifying, or deleting other users' data
- Avoid denial-of-service, spam, or automated high-volume traffic
- Stop testing and report promptly if you uncover sensitive data
- Give us reasonable time to investigate and remediate before public disclosure

## Bug Bounty

This project does not currently offer a bug bounty or paid disclosure program.
